Name: Redecorated Spouse Rooms
Author: Danielledaydreamer
Description:
This mod changes the appearance of the spouse room in your farmhouse. The red dot in the pictures shows where your spouse will stand. Unfortunately, you cannot place furniture (including rugs) on this tile, but you should be able to place furniture/rugs on any other unoccupied tile.

Note: This mod [b]requires Content Patcher[/b] (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915). After installing SMAPI and Content Patcher, simply place this mod in your Mods folder. I have only tested this mod with version 1.6 of Stardew Valley, so I can't promise it will work with older versions.

After Sebastian's 14-heart event, his table will be replaced by [spoiler]a frog tank.[/spoiler]
